ci_support_linux_64_c_compiler_version14:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cuda_compiler:
- cuda-nvcc
cuda_compiler_version:
- '12.9'
cudnn:
- '9'
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
github_actions_labels:
- namespace-profile-16cpu-on-linux-64
libabseil:
- '20260526'
libprotobuf:
- 7.35.1
numpy:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
- 3.12.* *_cpython
- 3.13.* *_cp313
- 3.14.* *_cp314
- 3.15.* *_cp315
re2:
- 2025.11.05
suffix:
- ''
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
  - c_stdlib_version
  - cuda_compiler_version
zlib:
- '1'

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.31.1"
  # The staging output builds the Python bindings for this version only; the
  # onnxruntime output rebuilds them for each Python version.
  staging_python: "3.13"
  suffix: ${{ suffix | default("") }}
  novec: ${{ suffix == "-novec" }}
  cuda_enabled: ${{ cuda_compiler_version != "None" }}
  # conda-forge's TensorRT needs glibc 2.28, which only the CUDA 13 builds target.
  tensorrt_enabled: ${{ linux and cuda_compiler_version == "13.4" }}
  build_number_base: 0
  build_number: ${{ build_number_base + (200 if cuda_enabled else 0) }}
  build_ext: ${{ ("cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | replace(".", ""))) if cuda_enabled else "cpu" }}

recipe:
  name: onnxruntime-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 92ffbf8b97872fd1e73c9eebdf3319d9a3b24919ae438d27db903b72ee08939e
  patches:
    # Workaround for https://github.com/conda-forge/onnxruntime-feedstock/pull/56#issuecomment-1586080419
    - if: win
      then:
        - patches/0001-avoid-conflicting-with-onnxruntime.dll-in-system32.patch
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/onnxruntime-feedstock/pull/128#issuecomment-2390332504
    - patches/0002-use-first-nvcc-found.patch
    # Improve compatibility between Visual Studio 19.41 + cuda 12.0 (they require 12.4 by default)
    # Upstream suggestion https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/22332
    - patches/0003-Add-_ALLOW_COMPILER_AND_STL_VERSION_MISMATCH-for-cud.patch
    # Fix endian.h shadowing system header for glibc 2.17
    - patches/0004-Remove-redundant-include-paths-from-custom-op-test-t.patch
    # New test in 1.28.0 lacks the skip guard its siblings have when onnx is absent
    - patches/0006-Skip-adapter-string-tensor-test-without-onnx.patch
    # autoep test gained a module-level onnx import in 1.28.0 but runs before
    # build.py's "onnx is not installed" gate
    - patches/0007-Guard-onnx-import-in-autoep-test.patch
    - patches/0008-Copy-python-test-files-in-batches.patch
    # new onnxruntime_public_exports_test in 1.31.0 needs bare cc/ar/nm
    - patches/0009-Use-CC-AR-NM-from-environment-in-test_gen_def.patch
    # abseil's CMake config only matches its exact version
    - patches/0011-Accept-any-installed-abseil-version.patch
    # protobuf deprecated RepeatedField::Resize; /sdl makes that an error on Windows
    - patches/0012-Use-RepeatedField-resize-instead-of-the-deprecated-R.patch
    # avoid loading both libprotobuf and libprotobuf-lite into one process
    - patches/0013-Link-the-full-libprotobuf-runtime-when-protobuf-is-p.patch
    # link conda-forge's libcoremltools instead of compiling the coremltools sources
    - if: osx and arm64
      then:
        - patches/0014-Use-a-preinstalled-libcoremltools-for-the-CoreML-EP.patch
    # the onnxruntime output reconfigures the staging build tree, which must not
    # rebuild the CUDA provider on Windows
    - patches/0015-Keep-the-timestamp-of-the-unchanged-CUDA-12.9-header.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    # Since 1.11, power9 seems to be required.
    - ppc64le
    - osx and x86_64
    # don't build cuda versions with novec
    - cuda_enabled and novec

outputs:
  # Builds libonnxruntime and everything the Python bindings need. The outputs
  # below reuse its build directory, so their build and host requirements must
  # match the ones here; otherwise CMake reconfigures and rebuilds everything.
  - staging:
      name: onnxruntime${{ suffix }}-build
    build:
      script:
        interpreter: nu
        file: build-cpp.nu
        env:
          cuda_compiler_version: ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
          suffix: ${{ suffix }}
          # RegexFullMatch.NonUtf8Pattern prints invalid UTF-8, which breaks
          # rattler-build's log output.
          # The QDQ MatMulNBits sharing-identity determinism assertion reads
          # uninitialized memory upstream and fails intermittently on linux-64.
          # FlashDecoding_LocalWindow_Reference_CPU expects a degree of
          # parallelism equal to the thread count, which the thread pool
          # multiplies on hybrid CPUs (e.g. Apple Silicon with efficiency cores).
          GTEST_FILTER: "-RegexFullMatch.NonUtf8Pattern:QDQTransformerTests.DefaultPath_TagsGeneratedWeightWithStableContentIdentity:GroupQueryAttentionTest.FlashDecoding_LocalWindow_Reference_CPU"
    requirements:
      # Keep in sync with the onnxruntime output.
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - nushell
        # protoc must run on the build platform
        - libabseil
        - libprotobuf
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python ${{ staging_python }}.*
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - pybind11
        - if: cuda_enabled
          then:
            - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
            - if: build_platform != target_platform
              then:
                - cuda-cudart-dev
                - cuda-nvrtc-dev
      # Keep in sync with the onnxruntime output.
      host:
        - python ${{ staging_python }}.*
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - wheel
        - numpy
        - pybind11
        - packaging
        - python-flatbuffers
        - libabseil
        - libprotobuf
        - re2
        - gmock
        - libdate
        - optional-lite
        - safeint
        - zlib
        - if: osx and arm64
          then:
            - libcoremltools
            # Used by the CoreML execution provider to build mlpackage models;
            # onnxruntime finds it via find_package, so prefer the conda-forge build.
            - nlohmann_json
        - if: cuda_enabled
          then:
            - cudnn
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - libcublas-dev
            - libcusparse-dev
            - libcurand-dev
            - libcufft-dev
            - cuda-cudart-dev
            - cuda-nvrtc-dev
        - if: tensorrt_enabled
          then:
            - libnvinfer-devel
            - libnvonnxparser-devel
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - zlib
          # libonnxruntime does not depend on Python
          - python
          - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
          - numpy
          - pybind11
          - if: tensorrt_enabled
            then:
              - libnvinfer-devel
              - libnvonnxparser-devel

  - package:
      name: onnxruntime${{ suffix }}-cpp
    inherit: onnxruntime${{ suffix }}-build
    build:
      string: h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}_${{ build_ext }}
      files:
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}include/onnxruntime/**
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/cmake/onnxruntime/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/lib/onnxruntime_*.lib
            - Library/bin/onnxruntime_*.dll
          else:
            - lib/libonnxruntime*
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('onnxruntime' ~ suffix ~ '-cpp', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
      run:
        # avoid that people without GPUs needlessly download ~0.5-1GB
        - if: cuda_enabled
          then:
            - __cuda
      run_constraints:
        - if: novec
          then:
            - onnxruntime-cpp <0a0
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - onnxruntime/core/session/onnxruntime_cxx_api.h
            - if: osx and arm64
              then:
                - onnxruntime/core/providers/coreml/coreml_provider_factory.h
          lib:
            - ${{ "onnxruntime_conda" if win else "onnxruntime" }}
            - if: cuda_enabled
              then:
                - onnxruntime_providers_shared
                - onnxruntime_providers_cuda
      - script:
          - if: linux
            then:
              - $CXX $CXXFLAGS -I$PREFIX/include/ -L$PREFIX/lib/ -lonnxruntime test.cpp
          - if: osx
            then:
              - $CXX $CXXFLAGS -I$PREFIX/include/ -L$PREFIX/lib/ -lonnxruntime -Wl,-rpath,$CONDA_PREFIX/lib test.cpp
          - if: unix
            then:
              - ./a.out
            else:
              - call .\run_cpp_test.bat
          - cmake-package-check onnxruntime --targets onnxruntime::onnxruntime
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake-package-check
        files:
          recipe:
            - test.cpp
            - if: win
              then:
                - run_cpp_test.bat

  - package:
      name: onnxruntime${{ suffix }}
    inherit: onnxruntime${{ suffix }}-build
    build:
      string: py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}_${{ build_ext }}
      script:
        interpreter: nu
        file: build-python.nu
        env:
          cuda_compiler_version: ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
      # The C++ library from the staging output belongs to onnxruntime-cpp. The
      # staging output's site-packages also holds bytecode of its host dependencies.
      # The location of site-packages varies, e.g. Python 3.15 on Windows uses
      # lib/python/site-packages instead of Lib/site-packages.
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/onnxruntime*/**"
      python:
        # This needs to be coherent with the entry_points list defined around
        # https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/main/setup.py#L735
        entry_points:
          - onnxruntime_test = onnxruntime.tools.onnxruntime_test:main
    requirements:
      # Keep in sync with the staging output; only the Python version differs.
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - nushell
        - libabseil
        - libprotobuf
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - pybind11
        - if: cuda_enabled
          then:
            - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
            - if: build_platform != target_platform
              then:
                - cuda-cudart-dev
                - cuda-nvrtc-dev
      # Keep in sync with the staging output; only the Python version differs.
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - wheel
        - numpy
        - pybind11
        - packaging
        - python-flatbuffers
        - libabseil
        - libprotobuf
        - re2
        - gmock
        - libdate
        - optional-lite
        - safeint
        - zlib
        - if: osx and arm64
          then:
            - libcoremltools
            - nlohmann_json
        - if: cuda_enabled
          then:
            - cudnn
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - libcublas-dev
            - libcusparse-dev
            - libcurand-dev
            - libcufft-dev
            - cuda-cudart-dev
            - cuda-nvrtc-dev
        - if: tensorrt_enabled
          then:
            - libnvinfer-devel
            - libnvonnxparser-devel
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - zlib
          - if: tensorrt_enabled
            then:
              - libnvinfer-devel
              - libnvonnxparser-devel
      run:
        - python
        - packaging
        - protobuf
        - python-flatbuffers
        # avoid that people without GPUs needlessly download ~0.5-1GB
        - if: cuda_enabled
          then:
            - __cuda
      run_constraints:
        - if: novec
          then:
            - onnxruntime <0a0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - onnxruntime
          pip_check: true
      - script:
          # CUDA builds must satisfy both PyPI names, see build-python.nu.
          - python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('onnxruntime') == '${{ version }}'"
          - if: cuda_enabled
            then:
              - python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('onnxruntime-gpu') == '${{ version }}'"
          - onnxruntime_test --help
          - if: osx and arm64
            then:
              # The CoreML execution provider is built into onnxruntime on Apple Silicon.
              - python -c "import onnxruntime as ort; assert 'CoreMLExecutionProvider' in ort.get_available_providers(), ort.get_available_providers()"
      - if: match(python, "3.12.*")
        then:
          # 2024/05 hmaarrfk/jtilly
          # Test the pip check command with numpy < 2
          # which was included in the requirements file for
          # build time compatibility
          - script:
              - pip check
            requirements:
              run:
                - pip
                - numpy 1.26.*

  # Separate from onnxruntime so that only users who want TensorRT pull in its runtime.
  - package:
      name: onnxruntime-ep-tensorrt
    inherit: onnxruntime${{ suffix }}-build
    build:
      skip:
        - not tensorrt_enabled
      string: py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}_${{ build_ext }}
      script:
        # onnxruntime looks for provider libraries next to the module that contains it,
        # which for the statically linked Python bindings is onnxruntime/capi.
        - install -D -m 755 build-ci/Release/libonnxruntime_providers_tensorrt.so "${SP_DIR}/onnxruntime/capi/libonnxruntime_providers_tensorrt.so"
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/onnxruntime/capi/libonnxruntime_providers_tensorrt.so
      dynamic_linking:
        # shipped by onnxruntime next to this library
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - "*/libonnxruntime_providers_shared.so"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
      host:
        - python
        - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - libnvinfer-devel
        - libnvonnxparser-devel
        - libprotobuf
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('onnxruntime' ~ suffix, exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          # onnxruntime loads libonnxruntime_providers_shared globally before any provider.
          - python -c "import ctypes, os, onnxruntime; capi = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(onnxruntime.__file__), 'capi'); [ctypes.CDLL(os.path.join(capi, f'libonnxruntime_providers_{p}.so'), os.RTLD_GLOBAL) for p in ('shared', 'tensorrt')]"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/
  summary: cross-platform, high performance ML inferencing and training accelerator
  license: MIT AND BSL-1.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - build-ci/Release/_deps/eigen3-src/COPYING.MPL2
    - build-ci/Release/_deps/flatbuffers-src/LICENSE
    - build-ci/Release/_deps/gsl-src/LICENSE
    - build-ci/Release/_deps/onnx-src/LICENSE
    - build-ci/Release/_deps/pytorch_cpuinfo-src/LICENSE
    - if: not unix

        - build-ci/Release/_deps/nlohmann_json-src/LICENSE.MIT
    - if: osx and arm64
      then:
        # Vendored at build time by onnxruntime for the CoreML execution provider.
        - build-ci/Release/_deps/fp16-src/LICENSE
        - build-ci/Release/_deps/psimd-src/LICENSE
